Source and built-public probes prove both spoof cases leave file existence/byte hash, snapshot, and private store stats unchanged and the next valid entry remains E-1. The prior 26 malformed cases, public factory/facets, single private store, redaction, strict snapshot/hydration, AgentRuntime sharing, fresh-process reopen identity, serialized V3 attestation, and 11 strict fault cards remain intact.

craftEvidence.value: The prior catch treated any Error whose public message started with ALEMBIC_AGENT_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_CAPTURE_INVALID as internally generated. A caller-controlled Proxy ownKeys trap or property getter could therefore throw Error('ALEMBIC_AGENT_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_CAPTURE_INVALID:CALLER_SPOOF'), pass the prefix test, and escape unchanged, forging Agent-owned error authority even though append remained untouched. The replacement creates one opaque token per validateCaptureInput invocation and records internally created validation Error identities with that token in a module-private WeakMap. Only an error registered for the current token retains its specific validation reason; arbitrary caller exceptions and errors replayed from earlier calls cannot match and are converted to UNREADABLE_INPUT. This entire classification occurs inside capture validation before store.append, so E-n allocation, in-memory state and JSONL mutation remain unreachable on rejection.
